newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains little changed in subdued market.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains little changed in subdued market.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended little changed in subdued trade, while physical trade stayed quiet.
Front month July was the most active wheat future, with 127 of a total 239 lots done. It last traded just 0.10 stg higher at 79.60 stg, having seen a low of 78.50 earlier in the day.
"It looks like it's found its lows and bounced off the bottom," one trader said of the old crop.
November last traded 0.10 stg down at 88.40, on volume of 92 lots. New crop months marked time during the afternoon, the trader said.
Just 10 lots of barley were traded, all on January, which last changed hands 0.25 stg higher at 86.50 stg.

The physical market remains subdued, although traders were not unhappy with the volume. "It's going to stay quiet until we get into July," one said, predicting little activity until the start of the harvest.
Delivered market brokers reported feed wheat done for July delivery to Norfolk/Suffolk at between 83.00 stg and 84.00 stg.
